t0008-01.gloss: A boundary separates the keys from the meal they travelled with.
t0008-01.rival_reading: A warehouse crew could separate access keys from stored supplies during a routine safety check; the chalk line may have nothing to do with evacuation.

t0008-02.gloss: A trial mixture remained active after application and damaged the test strip.
t0008-02.rival_reading: A farm worker could record ordinary crop damage and a poorly shut valve; the notes do not establish an experimental program.
